name: Console
tagline: An amber-lit flight console: one framed panel, telemetry in fixed seats, one green pass light, a cockpit status line above the prompt.
mood: Night cockpit: dark glass, amber legends, sand readouts; nothing moves unless something is running, and every number has a fixed seat.
rationale: A console is built to be glanced at: labels are short and uppercase, values sit in fixed columns, and a frame says where the instrument ends and the transcript begins. That answers the spacing complaint directly: every row is `│ gutter content … right-column gutter │`, every section is a labelled divider followed by its rows and one blank row, and the right column (sha, agent, time, counts) is a fixed 15-cell field aligned across the whole pane instead of a flexGrow push (it shrinks to 8 cells below 64 columns, but stays one width per pane). Character comes from a night cockpit's colour code, not from drafting ink: amber backlit legends (the WORKLOG nameplate, the section names set into the dividers, the beacon) on a dim bezel; sand phosphor for the live readouts (the meter fill, the running step's ● and the current phase's ▶, the mission clock, model names, counts); and exactly one green, the pass light: the gate ✓ in the strip, the band and SIGNALS (plus the finished ✓ and a 2 s beacon flash when a gate passes). Caution and warning stay the theme keys `warning` and `error`, so a `?` is caution-yellow and a `!` red on every terminal, and legend amber never stands on a content row beside those glyphs. That is also what keeps Console off its neighbours: Blueprint is blue ink with success-green meters and letter-spaced labels on its rules; Departure puts its amber on the meter and on every status flap, while Console's amber is four legends and one lamp on a dim frame, and its meter and live step are sand. The meter keeps the kit-shared ━/─ glyphs (only their tone changes), so this mod does not diverge from the other kit mods' progress glyphs.
tokenMap: bg: the terminal's own background (nothing painted; the pair's bg, near-black glass #0c0e10 / day #f7f6f3, is only the reference the accents were checked against). fg: default Text / `text`. dim: `dimColor` for the bezel: the frame, rules, ages, shas, done and todo glyphs, done rows, the band's `│` separators and the uppercase readout labels (STEPS, AGENTS, GATE, GIT, CTX, COST), so it follows the person's theme. accent (legend amber #e3a650 dark / #8a5a0a light): hex, for the backlit legends only: the WORKLOG nameplate, the section names set into the dividers, and the beacon; 9.1:1 on the dark reference bg (7.8:1 on #1e1e1e, 7.0:1 on Solarized #002b36), 5.5:1 on the light one (5.5:1 on Solarized light #fdf6e3, 5.9:1 on white). accent2 (sand phosphor #c9b58a / olive sand #5e5640): hex, for live readouts: the meter fill, the doing ● and current-phase ▶ (both bold), the health ▶ while working, the mission clock `T+3h12m`, elapsed `3h12m` in the band, model names and the phase count; 9.6:1 dark (8.3:1 on #1e1e1e, 7.5:1 on #002b36), 6.7:1 light (6.8:1 on #fdf6e3, 7.3:1 on white). bg2 (#302a20 / #e2d9c6): hex, used ONLY as the `hover` background of keyed step rows and band buttons, a 1.36:1 / 1.30:1 warm lift that reads as a highlight, never as structure (amber 6.7:1 / 4.2:1 and sand 7.1:1 / 5.2:1 on it); no row paints a background (a painted strip is invisible on VS Code dark and Solarized and a dent on lighter themes), the frame and the blank rows carry the layout. success/warning/error: always the theme keys, never hex. `success` is the pass light and lights only the gate ✓ (strip, band, SIGNALS), the finished ✓ (health and beacon) and the 2 s beacon flash after a gate passes; `warning` is caution (`?`, `~`, decision ids, the footer count); `error` is the red light (`!`, `✗`). The three semantic hex entries in each palette are reference-only (what the page preview paints, set yellower than the legend amber so legend amber, sand readout and caution yellow are three tones in the preview, as they are against a stock terminal theme) and are never emitted by the mod. Legend amber and `warning` are kept apart by place as well as hue: accent appears only on the rails and dividers, never on a content row, so it never shares the glyph columns (2 and 4) where every warning glyph sits, and the only accent2 glyphs in those columns are ● and ▶, shapes warning never takes; on light themes the two ambers are close in hue (#8a5a0a against a stock light warning near #966c1e), so the placement rule is what carries the distinction there. The hex pairs are picked by the person's `theme` row from `$.config.list()`: the light pair when the value starts with `light`, otherwise the dark pair, including when the row is missing or carries a value the mod does not know (`dark-ansi`, a relabelled row); re-picked on `config.set {key:'theme'}`.

otherTabs: Plan keeps the frame and the `├─ PLAN ─ ✓ A  ▶ B  ○ C ─┤` divider (amber legend, sand ▶ B, the rest dim); every phase is a header row (`▾ A  API` / `▸ C  Docs`) with its count in the right column and its steps below in the same 15-cell field. Log is `├─ LOG ─ 3 ─┤` with a 6-cell dim HH:MM column, Rulings in `warning` with the word RULING as the label. Step details open as `┌─ STEP B3 ─ ● DOING 6m ─┐` (amber legend, sand ●) with an 8-cell uppercase dim label column (STATUS, NOTE, COMMIT, GATE, AGENTS, DRIFT, ASKS) and the nav keys (`b: Back  k: Prev  j: Next`) in the footer line. Needs you is `├─ NEEDS YOU ─ 1 ─┤`: the question bold, a dim meta row `ASKED 16:05  BLOCKS B4`, a WHY row, the options as `[ per seat ]` buttons with the recommended one primary, the text field beneath on terminal and desktop (a dim `Reply in chat` button on the phone, as today), then `├─ NOTICED ─┤` and `├─ ANSWERED ─┤` in the same rhythm. Finished: the beacon becomes a steady green ✓, the rail clock reads `TOOK 2h05m` (the band `took 2h05m`), the health is a green ✓, the meter is all sand ━ and the NEEDS YOU section is gone; with only drift the divider reads `~ NOTICED`; an empty plan draws STEPS 0/0 and an all-─ meter.

All width-1 BMP; ◉ ◎ ○ ● ─ ━ │ are East-Asian-ambiguous, which Western-locale terminals draw as one cell.
spacingRules: Frame: 2 bars + a 1-cell gutter inside each, so content is `columns - 4` (68 at the mocked 72). Rhythm per section: divider row, its rows, one blank row; the header block is top rail, title row, status strip, blank. Indent levels: titles, questions and phase headers at the gutter (column 2); the strip's readouts, step rows and SIGNALS readouts all at +2 (column 4). Id/age column: step ids, decision ids and drift ages are `padEnd(4)` + 1 space (5 cells), so `D1`, `D12`, `B10`, `2.3`, `3m` and `1h2m` all start their text in the same column; phase keys at the gutter are `padEnd(2)` + 1 space. Right column: a fixed 15-cell field right-aligned to the gutter: `MODEL(6) TIME(3, right) TOOL(4)` for agents, shas right-aligned to the same edge, counts (`2/6`, `blocks B4`) right-aligned. SIGNALS: a 4-cell uppercase dim label + 3 cells, a 12-cell value, an 8-cell age, a 7-cell right-aligned dim extra (`52s`, `6 today`); the second column CTX/COST has a 4-cell label + 2 cells and a 6-cell right-aligned value. Status strip: no background; readouts spaced by 3, label and value by 2. Colour by column: columns 2 and 4 are the glyph columns (health, `?`, `~` and the phase ▶ at 2; step glyphs at 4); legend amber never enters them because it never appears on a content row (it lives only on the rails, in the dividers and in the beacon's seat at the top rail's right end), and the accent2 glyphs that do (● ▶) are shapes warning never takes, so `?` and `~` are the only caution marks in a glyph column. Band: segments separated by ` │ ` in dim, no `GIT` label (a 7-hex sha is self-identifying) and elapsed as `3h12m`, so the left side is 83 cells on the sample against a room of 89 and the drop behaviour is no worse than today's (`bandSegments` keeps `room = columns - right - 3` and its 1-cell paddingX; the counts sit at the right with at least 1 cell of air). Degrade: below 56 columns the bars and gutters go and dividers draw as `─ LABEL ───` without joins (content = columns - 2, as today); below 64 columns the right field is 8 cells (sha only, `opus 6m`, the count); when rows < 14 the strip folds into the title row (`! Add team billing  7/18 ━━━━──────  2 agents`) and the blank after the header goes, so header chrome is 2 rows against `budget = rows - 4`. Two-column mode (inline, width >= 96): `blocks B4` moves to a dim meta row under the question so the question keeps the half's full width. Never adjacent: a value and the next label (always 2+ cells), a divider and the previous section's last row (always a blank), the footer and the frame (the bottom rail sits between).
desktopNotes: Proportional font, so the hand-drawn frame and ├─┤ dividers are not drawn there. Each section becomes a `Box borderStyle="round" paddingX={1}` (border in the `inactive` theme key, the bezel) whose first row is the uppercase legend in accent amber bold (what `rule()` already does on !isMono, now inside a border), with marginTop 1 between sections. Rows keep `Text | flexGrow | Box width={15}` so the right column's edge aligns by flex, and inside that field the agent readout is three Text children in a row Box (`Box width={6}` model in sand, `Box width={3}` time, `Box width={4}` tool, gap 1) so MODEL/TIME/TOOL line up across rows without spaces. SIGNALS on !isMono is a row of fixed-width Boxes (label Box width 7, value Box width 12, age Box width 8, extra Box width 7, gap 2; CTX/COST label 6 + value 6), so the grid holds in a proportional font; below 48 columns of width it falls back to today's `gate ✓ 4m · 52s` single-line form, the ✓ still the only green. The status strip is a `Box paddingX={1} gap={3}` of label/value pairs with no background and the meter fill in sand; the top rail collapses into the title row: `! Add team billing   ◉ T+3h12m` (◉ amber, clock sand). The band keeps its text and dim `│` separators with the counts pushed right by flexGrow. Mobile: the same single column, the strip wraps to two rows, the footer buttons wrap, the beacon is a static amber ◉ Text (no Client there), the needs-you text field is the `Reply in chat` button. Two-column inline mode (terminal, width >= 96): one outer frame, the PLAN half on the left and NEEDS YOU + SIGNALS on the right; the centre rule is a plain dim `│` column with no joins, the halves' dividers end in `─` on the inner side (`├─ PLAN ───` left, `─── ┤` right only against the outer bar), and the rails carry `┬`/`┴` at `half + 2`; each half keeps its own 15-cell right column.

animation.idea: The beacon ◉ in the top rail is the console's one moving part: an amber link light that pulses only while something is running.
animation.trigger: An agent running (facts.agents has status running) or a gate run in progress starts the pulse: ◉ in legend amber (accent) alternating with ◎ in sand (accent2), a change of shape and tone rather than an on/off blink, so it reads as a lamp breathing and never as a flashing master caution. A gate passing shows the beacon as ◉ in the `success` theme key for 2 s (the pass light, the same green as the GATE readout beside it), then it returns to amber, or to the resting ○ when nothing else runs; ✓ is reserved for the finished run. A gate failing leaves the beacon alone: the health `✗` (error) and the band carry that. A step marked done repaints the strip meter once (no animation). A question raised does nothing here: `warning` on the health glyph and the band counts carries it, so the amber lamp is never asked to mean caution. Amber and sand are the palette hex picked by the theme row; the flash is the theme key.
animation.cadence: 1 frame per second (◉ amber, ◎ sand, ◉ amber) while an agent or gate runs; no frames at all when nothing runs, on mobile, in VS Code, or once finished.
animation.staticFrame: Amber ◉ (accent) when agents run or a gate is running, dim ○ when nothing runs, green ✓ (`success`) when finished; this is also what every non-Client surface draws.

feasibility: The frame is not a `Box.borderStyle`: an engine border cannot carry the WORKLOG legend, the clock or the `├ ┤` joins, so in the terminal every row is a row Box of `│` Text + gutter + content + flexGrow + a fixed 15-cell right Box + `│`, and the rails and dividers are Text rows sized to `columns`, exactly as `ruleParts` sizes rules today. Buttons sit inside rows as they do now. If the owner prefers the engine's border, the fallback is one outer `Box borderStyle="single"` with the title in the first inner row and dividers as `─ LABEL ───` without joins. Nothing paints a background: the strip is a plain row, and bg2 appears only as a keyed Box `hover` background. The amber-and-sand look is a palette and tone change on the same Text elements: the meter fill, the doing ● / current ▶ and the working health move from `success` to the accent2 hex and done ✓ to dimColor, so no width changes and every measured line holds. Legend amber sits near `warning` in hue on light themes; that is carried by placement (accent only on rails and dividers, never on a content row, stated in spacingRules), and if a person's theme makes the two indistinguishable the legends can fall back to `text` bold without touching layout. The beacon is a 1-cell Client in the terminal and desktop, a static Text elsewhere. The glyph set is all width-1 BMP and the meter stays the kit-shared ━/─. The band's segments and drop order are unchanged, so it stays one row at every width; narrow panes drop the frame rather than squeezing titles.
implementationNotes:
- `rule()` in mono mode becomes `divider(label, tail)` drawing `├─ LABEL ─…─ tail ─┤` (label in palette.accent, bold; line in dimColor), plus `rail(top|bottom)`; a `frameRow(left, right)` helper wraps a row in `│` + 1-cell gutters and places `right` in a `Box width={15}` (8 below 64 columns); below 56 columns `frameRow` draws no bars and `divider` draws `─ LABEL ───` without joins; on `!isMono` these fall back to a round-bordered section Box (border `inactive`) with the existing label-with-marginTop row.
- Header: `h1` becomes the top rail (WORKLOG legend in accent, beacon, `T+` clock in accent2) and the title moves to row 2; `h2` becomes the status strip (readouts STEPS / AGENTS / GATE as dim uppercase label + value with gap 3, no background); when rows < 14 the strip folds into the title row. `meter()` glyphs are unchanged (━/─).
- Tones, a behaviour change from today with tests: `TONE` (view.tsx:38) doing → palette.accent2 + bold, done → dimColor; the band `bar` segment (:106) and the pane meter (:596) → palette.accent2; the phase ▶ (:350) and the step glyph Text (:415) → accent2 for doing/current and dimColor for done; `healthOf` (:63) working returns a `live` tone that `drawBand`/`drawPane` resolve to palette.accent2 (the gate tone at :75 and the finished ✓ stay `success`). Test: on the running, unfinished sample, `success` appears only on the band's gate segment and the pane's GATE readouts; on a finished run the health ✓ is `success` too.
- Band: `·` separators become ` │ ` in dimColor, labels AGENTS / GATE uppercase dim, the git segment is `9e1d0aa 2m` with no label, elapsed stays `3h12m` / `took 2h05m` in accent2; `bandSegments` keys, drop levels and the right counts stay as they are (test: left side is 83 cells on the sample at 100 columns, 6 cells of slack).
- `stepRow`: id column `id.padEnd(4) + ' '`; right column `model.padEnd(6) time.padStart(3) tool.padEnd(4)` (model accent2, time and tool dim) for a running linked agent on ANY status, a behaviour change from today's `agent && step.status === 'doing'`, with a test (`stepRow` shows a running linked agent on a todo step: `○ B5 … sonnet 1m`) and a README line under "What you see" (`Agents fold into their step's row, including a step still todo`); shas padStart(15); `signalsBlock` becomes two aligned rows with 4-cell labels, a dim 7-cell extra column and a second CTX/COST column.
- A `palette.ts` with the dark pair (accent #e3a650, accent2 #c9b58a, bg2 #302a20) and the light pair (#8a5a0a, #5e5640, #e2d9c6) and `pickPalette(themeRow?: string)` (light when the value starts with `light`, otherwise dark, missing row included; test both and an unknown value); `register.tsx` reads the `theme` row from `$.config.list()` at session start and on `config.set {key:'theme'}` and passes the pair into `drawBand`/`drawPane`; semantic tones stay theme keys; keyed step rows and band buttons get `hover={{ backgroundColor: palette.bg2 }}`.
- Beacon: a surface module `beacon.ts` for a 1-cell Client (`every(1000)` toggling ◉ in accent / ◎ in accent2, props `{running, gate, finished, palette}` set from the hooks on agent/gate changes; the 2 s `success` flash is a `gatePassedAt` prop the Client compares against its clock); footer labels become `1: Overview` style in sentence case with the active tab as an inverse Text chip inside its Button.
